title: 3D Observer Form [A(v),B(v),C(v),F(v),H(v)]
text: Implement gain-scheduled state-space controller in observer form depending on three scheduling parameters, 5 inputs, 1 output; {A-matrix(v1,v2,v3)} sets a -matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix(v1,v2,v3)} sets the b -matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix(v1,v2,v3)} sets the c -matrix of the state-space implementation, {F-matrix(v1,v2,v3)} sets the f -matrix of the state-space implementation, {H-matrix(v1,v2,v3)} sets the h -matrix of the state-space implementation, {First scheduling variable (v1) breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for first scheduling variable, {Second scheduling variable (v2) breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for second scheduling variable, {Third scheduling variable (v3) breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for third scheduling variable and {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix(v1,v2,v3)
params.values: A -matrix of the state-space implementation A (default) | array

params.name: B-matrix(v1,v2,v3)
params.values: B -matrix of the state-space implementation B (default) | array

params.values: C -matrix of the state-space implementation C (default) | array

params.values: F -matrix of the state-space implementation F (default) | array

params.name: H-matrix(v1,v2,v3)
params.values: H -matrix of the state-space implementation H (default) | array

params.values: Breakpoints for first scheduling variable v1_vec (default)
